---
params:
  region: "Montréal"
  num_cols: 3
title: '`r sprintf("Observation d’espèces pour la région %s", params$region)`'
output: 
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
  # pdf_document: default
---

```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

# Assume sp_list_fil_all is already in your environment 
# or loaded here:
sp_list_fil_all <- read.csv2(
  file = file.path(
    "~/Github_proj/evologie/InCubateur/2025_05_24_Guide_biodiv_qc",
    "output/partie_2/sp_list_fil_all.csv"))

# 1. Filter by Region
data_filtered <- sp_list_fil_all %>%
  filter(MRS_NM_REG == params$region) %>%
  arrange(class, desc(n))

# 2. Define the classes we want to display
target_classes <- c("Amphibia", "Squamata", "Testudines", "Mammalia", "Aves")

```


```{r run_script, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# Loop through each class to create sections and grids
for (current_class in target_classes) {
  
  # Filter data for this specific section
  class_data <- data_filtered |> 
    filter(class == current_class)
  
  if (nrow(class_data) > 0) {
    # Create Section Header
    cat("\n##", current_class, "\n\n") # Niveau 1 
    
    # Get unique Orders in this class, sorted by the max 'n' found in each order
    orders <- class_data %>% 
      group_by(order) %>% 
      summarise(max_n = max(n, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
      arrange(desc(max_n)) %>% 
      pull(order)
    
    for (current_order in orders) {
      order_data <- class_data %>% filter(order == current_order)
      cat("\n## Order:", current_order, "\n\n") # Subsection (Level 2)
      
      # Get unique Families in this order, sorted by max 'n'
      families <- order_data %>% 
        group_by(family) %>% 
        summarise(max_n = max(n, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
        arrange(desc(max_n)) %>% 
        pull(family)
      
      for (current_family in families) {
        family_data <- order_data %>% filter(family == current_family) %>% arrange(desc(n))
        cat("\n### Family:", current_family, "\n\n") # Sub-subsection (Level 3)
        
        # Start the Grid for this Family
        cat('<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(', params$num_cols, ', 1fr); gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 40px;">\n', sep="")
        
        for (i in 1:nrow(family_data)) {
          row <- family_data[i, ]
          img_path <- path.expand(row$fichier_photo)
          
          # HTML Block - NO leading indentation
          cat(sprintf('<div style="text-align: center; margin-bottom: 20px;">
<img src="%s" style="width: 100%%; border-radius: 8px;">
<p>
<strong>%s</strong><br>
<em>%s</em> (%s)<br>
<small>Observations: %s</small>
</p>
</div>',
path.expand(file.path("~/Github_proj/evologie/", row$fichier_photo)), 
row$fr_nm, 
row$species, 
row$name_comm, 
row$n
          ))
        }
        
        cat('\n</div>\n') # End Family Grid
      }
    }
    cat("\n--- \n") # Divider between Classes
  }
}
```
